name: Flexomornis
sum: Cenomanian enantiornithean from the Woodbine Formation of Texas, among the oldest North American birds.
holotype: Fragmentary bones from the Lewisville Member of the Woodbine Formation (number in Tykoski and Fiorillo 2010).
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Tykoski and Fiorillo 2010
